map-fu-reference: Indicates only the relationship between a functional requirement and the physical flows that fulfill it; the two are not synonyms.
Conversion requires explicit performance, service life, use conditions, and quantitative basis.
map-water-withdrawal-consumption: Identified by named definitions within the same source watershed, period, and return-flow destination; withdrawal and consumption are not synonymous volumes.
A simple withdrawal-minus-return ledger requires a single consistent accounting basis and does not supply storage, transfer, or local impact modeling.
map-water-inventory-background: Product-inventory water consumption and the background water state used to generate characterization factors belong to different layers; sharing a volumetric unit does not make them interchangeable.
Use named variable definitions and retain the marginal validity conditions of the factor.
map-average-marginal-ecosystem: In the cited guidance, one expresses average response relative to a chosen target while the other takes the local slope at an operating point.
Comparison requires stating the same response function, target, and operating point; identical units or numerical values do not establish conceptual equivalence.
map-marginality-contexts: Respectively bound an inventory perturbation to a water background and the local slope of an ecological response curve.
Sharing the word 'marginal' does not imply the same model, target, or operating point; any mathematical link must be shown within a specific model.
map-hist-service-trippage: Applies only to the same filling/beverage-delivery service reference in the 1974 report.
Trippage N links new-bottle makeup to repeated fillings; it cannot scale all processes uniformly and does not equal a recycling rate or guaranteed individual bottle lifetime.
map-hist-two-trippages: Compares repeated use of two distinct objects within the cited historical container system.
The two count different objects; the original report can hold bottle trippage fixed while varying secondary-packaging trips, so they are not interchangeable parameters.
map-ped-precision-variability: Requires fixing the same population and estimation target first.
Population dispersion of cup weights enters mean-precision calculations, but the two describe different objects and cannot be substituted merely because they share units.
map-ped-gsd-squared: Squaring or taking square roots converts representations only when U = g² is explicitly defined and all inputs/outputs follow the same statistical convention.
A representation transform does not make the two quantities numerically equal, nor does it guarantee database field semantics or distributional fit.
map-market-average-response: An average mix describes a defined period/boundary and trade attribution; marginal technology describes activity changes under a specified perturbation.
Approximating change by an average mix requires separate evidence that actual response matches the average; this relation does not authorize general equivalence or numerical substitution.
map-hyb-bridge-directions: The first takes unit process operation as its denominator; the second takes monetary economic-sector output. Each rests on actual purchase or sales records.
map-hyb-residual-inventory: In a construction where named processes and the economic system are bidirectionally linked and original transactions are separable, the residual table describes the background after subtracting already-modeled activities. Other hybrid forms have their own linking and correction rules.
map-es-references: The two annual flows supply the normalization reference and the target denominator for the weighting ratio respectively. Region, year, substance, and mass basis must be verified before comparison.
map-lime-wtp-share: When unit damage valuations, same-edition annual damage references, compatible areas of protection, and units are all aligned within the same study, each category's share of total annual monetary damage can be computed.
map-lime-policy: Both aggregate across distinct burdens: the former estimates damage valuation via survey trade-offs and monetary attributes, whereas the latter derives eco-points per unit flow from current flows and policy targets.
map-lime-decision: Hypothetical damage valuations expressed in Japanese yen and an organization's actual cost accounting have different actors, payment contexts, and decision purposes.
map-cn-reference-localization: Within the reviewed Chinese normalization literature, regional per-capita reference totals are one component of localization and are not equivalent to localized inventory or damage models.
map-cn-adoption-localization: A project's adoption of one reference set does not carry over to adopting its weights, all underlying models, or all editions.
map-cycle-quality-flow: Functional performance equivalence, processing yield, and market response cannot be collapsed into a single factor without a common denominator.
map-cycle-handoff-flow: Burden-sharing sums across fixed processes and responses of activities outside the system must be verified separately; transferring accounting credit does not alter physical material routes.
map-rule-function: Methodological conformity is judged only after fixing document edition, product category, intended use, and service; identical volume or name cannot replace functional and comparative conditions.
map-rp-data-fitness: A representative product is a real or virtual object built under the stated category and dataset; it does not automatically represent a specific company, current market, or every product.
map-model-layer-review: Distinguish activities, published outputs, native models, category reviews, and company-study verifications; treat only materials actually inspected as evidence for their respective layer.
map-pm-intake-toxic-pathway: A shared pathway decomposition supports stage-by-stage questioning only; substance, medium, intake definition, and health coverage remain method-specific and factors are not directly interchangeable.
map-pm-ecosystem-slopes: Conditional mathematical relations between local and interval slopes do not transfer response objects, policy targets, or health counterfactuals; each operating point and endpoint requires separate evidence.
map-pm-health-endpoint: Verify first whether a factor already incorporates severity and its unit; effect metrics defined per case, per inhaled mass, or per ambient concentration cannot be chained by name alone.
map-pm-factor-model-evidence: Distinguish journal equations, published summaries, operational spreadsheets, and software mappings; local numerical checks do not prove an entire native generation chain or real-world intervention outcome.
map-power-delivery-reference: Delivered electricity must first match function, performance, timing, and voltage level; identical energy quantity does not automatically establish identical end-use service.
map-power-generation-consumption: Keep the same region, year, and carrier while explicitly treating trade, storage, and losses; a generation average cannot become a consumption mix merely by changing the denominator.
map-power-response-production: Procedural supplier identification, historical statistical estimation, and native model evaluation each carry distinct conditions; the label 'marginal' does not equate short-run fixed-capital response with long-run supply technology.
map-power-future-scenarios: State capital, weather, technology, policy, hourly weighting, and impact-method assumptions explicitly; intra-model comparisons do not prove future reality or cross-model equivalence.
map-native-provider-waste: Restricted to named flow types, directions, reference amounts, and stored links; a record's parseability does not prove that required treatment activities enter the solver.
map-native-preservation-reference: Check reference exchanges, independent system goals, and parameter evaluation separately; equal mass cannot substitute for item count, performance, or service equivalence.
map-cml-evaluation-improvement: The 1992 environmental trade-offs, reliability/validity checks, and design analysis are linked, but full technical-financial judgment and real implementation are not covered by evaluation of the same name.
map-cml-diagnosis-decision: Local response holds other inputs fixed; feasibility must be checked and all coupled changes reconstructed before comparing with the original design—parameter sensitivity alone does not prove actual net benefit.
map-cml-uptake-conditions: US EPA (1994) selected named factors and applied its own tiering, modifications, and aggregation; numerical or bibliographic links do not imply adoption of all CML valuation procedures, weights, or checks.
map-climate-gwp-gtp: Sharing the same gas and nominal time horizon does not erase the difference between integrated radiative forcing and endpoint temperature change; each metric also carries its own reference denominator.
map-climate-pulse-time: Under a linear fixed background, mass pulses are evaluated at their respective elapsed times; a common calendar endpoint and a fixed post-emission horizon are defined separately.
map-climate-rate-pulse: The 2019 rate-based expression takes prescribed GWP values and historical emission rates as inputs; it does not yield a history-free static factor per unit product, nor does it determine allocation rules.
